title: Assert one Helm probe's fields in CI by scoping the grep to its block
answers: how to test a helm probe override in CI without matching another probe
helm template grep check for readinessProbe field
how to check helm probe omission in workflow
body:
The "Render probes" step in .github/workflows/helm.yml defines probe_block <probeKey>, an awk helper that prints only the 10-space-indented block under that key (e.g. 'readinessProbe:') until the next sibling key.
Assert a field by piping through it: echo "$out" | probe_block 'readinessProbe:' | grep -q '^            failureThreshold: 9$'. Probe fields sit at 12 spaces and httpGet children at 14, which follow nindent 12 in charts/templates/deployment.yaml.
To assert omission, capture render into a variable first, then `if echo "$disabled" | grep -q 'startupProbe:'` and exit 1 on match, so a failed helm template stays fatal rather than looking like a correct omission.
Add a negative case when scoping: an override routed to the wrong probe must fail the block-scoped check. The PR author verified this.
If nindent changes in the template, update the indentation patterns in these greps.
applies: Adding render assertions for probe fields in .github/workflows/helm.yml or other chart render checks that must target one probe.
says: Automated chart build checks match settings on the wrong deployment health probe
Verify deployment readiness and startup probe overrides independently during pipeline validation runs
Template rendering failures appear as successful probe omissions in the build workflow
Ensure automated test checks fail if health probe settings route to the wrong probe
search: In .github/workflows/helm.yml, render assertions for probe fields isolate individual probe blocks using the probe_block awk helper. Matching checks probe keys at 10 spaces, probe fields at 12 spaces, and httpGet children at 14 spaces per nindent 12 in charts/templates/deployment.yaml. To assert probe omission, capture rendered output first and grep for the probe key, exiting with code 1 on match to keep template rendering errors fatal. Scoping must include negative tests ensuring misplaced overrides fail, and grep indentation must be updated if template nindent changes.
